page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores operating at 2.9 GHz with x86_64 architecture and 310.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.46 GB of RAM per core. The instance integrates a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. No local storage is bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in large language model (LLM) inference tasks. For a 135M parameter model, the instance achieves prompt processing speeds of 9,711.08 tokens per second and text generation speeds of 456.51 tokens per second. For a medium 7B model, it processes prompts at 2,509.43 tokens per second and generates text at 90.44 tokens per second. Multi-threaded operations are also strong, with bzip3 decompression reaching 230.87 GB/sec and Geekbench image processing scoring in the top 25%. CPU encryption performance is similarly robust, registering a strong Passmark encryption score of 42,228.64.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge offers a balanced allocation of dedicated CPU cores and a mid-range enterprise GPU, avoiding the higher costs associated with multi-GPU configurations. The absence of local storage represents a key architectural tradeoff, requiring users to factor in external storage costs. This instance is highly suited for small-to-medium LLM inference, image processing, cryptographic workloads, and parallelized data decompression tasks.
